review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached leads. It is joined to the atlas by the election of 4 October 2015 and the agreements of that November, both of whose records already name the Greens, and by the standing coalition with the PCP that this record carries as a relation.

summary: The Ecologist Party "The Greens" was founded in 1982 and has stood at every election in coalition with the Communist Party — in the Aliança Povo Unido and then in the Coligação Democrática Unitária. It is a member of the European Greens and was a founding member of the European Federation of Green Parties.
